about: A region reads a world's files and what the views of the places pinning it ask, when a region it declares names them. Each file of a world, a place that holds its own capsule lock, is handed as coordinate/<path> at the path the place speaks it, out of foreign trees and dot directories, at the place in the tree, in the release the tree renders of it and in its clone alike. Each region the world renders is handed as asked/<region> with the count of pinning places whose written views name it, read from the locks at fold time; that is the tree's to say, so a released fold is handed none of it, as it is handed none of the judge's lists. A place that holds no capsule lock is handed neither.
